caption: A hand is held in front of a projector lens, and a dark hand shape covers part of the picture on the screen.

sa.check: A projector shows a picture on a screen.
A hand is held in front of the lens.
A dark hand shape covers part of the picture on the screen.
The shape covers only part of the picture, not all of it.
The hand goes in front of the lens first and the dark shape appears with it.

pc.expect: The dark shape matches the hand and changes the instant the fingers move.
pc.fail: It is a different shape from the hand; or it stays fixed while the fingers move; or it changes while the hand is still.

pc.expect: The dark shape appears only while the hand is in the beam and disappears the moment the hand is withdrawn.
pc.fail: It lingers after the hand is gone; or it appears with the hand outside the beam; or it appears before the hand enters.

pc.expect: The dark shape does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It drifts across the screen with the hand still; or it moves before the hand.

pc.expect: The dark shape is much larger than the hand and has a soft edge.
pc.fail: It is smaller than the hand; or has a hard geometric edge unlike a hand; or it splits into unrelated pieces.

pc.expect: One hand and one dark shape.
pc.fail: A second dark shape appears under one beam; or the hand loses a finger; or the shape becomes solid; or the hand passes through the lens.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The picture and the screen stay the same, and the shape stays dark.
pc.fail: The picture changes with no click; or the shape turns bright; or the screen changes.

note: The hand is the object blocking the beam; the person is not judged.
